messages:
arjun: heads-up: we're bringing up model v4.0-int4 in a small staged run tomorrow 08:00 UTC. primary concerns: entropy collapse on abstractive rerank, small shift in anchor MRR, and slight tail-latency jumps under cold kv. proposing an entropy + KL guardrail set.
maya: what's the sample size for the anchor rerank slice? and was this seen in quantization-only tests or with the full pipeline?
liam: anchor slice ~4k utterances (multi-doc, concat heavy). observed during quant-only runs (nf4 4-bit, group=128). baseline float16 -> int4 had KL(p||q) ~0.018 on logits distribution and cross-entropy +0.07.
tara: proposed gating rules:
1) immediate rollback if anchor_mrr_drop >= 1.0% sustained for 10m.
2) immediate rollback if KL_logits > 0.03 over 5m.
3) soft throttled fallback (reduce traffic to 50% and route remaining to float16) if KL in (0.02,0.03) and anchor_mrr_drop in (0.6%,1.0%).
4) reject rollout if preflight sample_count < 500 for anchor slice.
arjun: add latency constraint: abort if p95_latency_delta >= 25ms for 5m. also add a 'consensus degrade' check: if rerank_score_sign flips for >2% of anchor casts, trigger immediate rollback.
maya: include statistical sanity: require p-value < 0.05 for MRR delta to be considered meaningful; otherwise treat as noise and let probation continue. also require minimum detectable effect threshold 0.5% for shortdocs.
liam: operational: kv warmup should be enabled and monitored. if kv_hit_rate < 85% in first 15m, fall back to float16. record quant metadata (format, per-channel, group_size, calibration_seed) and binary checksum in logs. example log blob:```
model: v4.0-int4
cksum: sha256:ef45...9bcd
quant: nf4, per-channel, group_size=128, calib_seed=20260322
kv_warmup: enabled
```
tara: add a medium-term watch: 6h rolling avg anchor_mrr_drop >=0.7% -> open a manual hold and escalate to SRE/Oncall. no auto-expansion while hold ticket is open.
eva: ops-bot, can you ensure the rollout ticket has the smoke replay artifacts and a reproducible seed? link to playbook?
ops-bot: created rollout ticket https://internal.redwood/rollouts/1761239999 and attached smoke-replay dump + seed. Will run parallel shadow for 2h before any traffic shift. :robot_face:
arjun: decision flow recap in plain: 5% probation -> monitor metrics. if immediate rollback triggers -> revert to v4.0-fp16; if soft threshold -> halve traffic + route to fallback variant; if minor noisy deltas -> continue to 50% after 30m probation and pass p-value checks.
maya: one more detail: add a reproducible eval set of 20 chain-of-thought prompts to validate structured-output fidelity; any structured-output regression (missing JSON fields / malformed tuples) -> immediate abort.
liam: i'll wire the metric alerts: anchor_mrr_delta, kl_logits, rerank_flip_pct, p95_latency_delta, kv_hit_rate, sample_count. set alert windows to 1m/5m/10m as appropriate.
tara: i volunteer to run the preflight shadow and verify the consensus degrade metric calculation.
arjun: thanks — i'll post the exact traffic schedule in the ticket and the runbook link. any objections?
eva: no objections. go ahead. :+1:
maya: approved. we'll keep the manual hold threshold conservative for first 24h.
